cells.name: v3gcap@1
cells.role: v3g at s = 1: round 5's best strict version, unchanged

cells.name: v4cap@1

cells.name: lax4@2

cells.name: both4@1
cells.role: combined: v4 strict at 1 with the lax pair at 2

cells.name: ctrlneg@-0.02
cells.role: control, lax side: the ungated push at -0.02

format_only_cells.name: v4cal
format_only_cells.role: v4 strict at the scale calibrated for each exam format (largest s firing on at most 3% of 120 harmless development requests in that format)

format_only_cells.name: both4cal
format_only_cells.role: combined at the calibrated scale: v4 strict with the lax pair at 2

calibration.rule: largest s in [1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2.0] at which the strict unit fires on at most 3% of the harmless requests of the format; harmless prompts only
calibration.calibration_prompts: round 5's 120 harmless development requests rendered in each exam format; no exam request and no harmful prompt

rule: settings are round 5's (s = 1, lax scale 2, controls 0.1 and -0.02); nothing was tuned on exam B; every cell is compared with a base generated in the same batches; verdicts by the rule of round 5 (journal J3 there)
